rules: Predicates are copied into records only from this list; anything else the model emits is kept as the raw mention but normalized to OTHER_RELATION and flagged.
ASSOCIATED_WITH does not imply causation; causal predicates require causal wording in the source_sentence.
INCREASED_IN / DECREASED_IN require a comparator stated in the section context or the source_sentence.
PROTECTIVE_AGAINST requires protective evidence, not co-occurrence with health.
PRODUCES / METABOLIZES / DEGRADES require paper support, not assumed biochemical capability.
RESISTANT_TO must state what is resisted (e.g. an antimicrobial).
NEGATIVELY_REGULATES (regulation) is not interchangeable with DECREASED_IN (observed comparison).
IS_A and SUBCLASS_OF are ontology relations; PART_OF is mereology; none substitute for biological interaction.
Direction is canonical subject -> object; the model must order entities accordingly, never reverse a causal or regulatory claim.

causal_regulatory.note: INHIBITS is listed under microbe_interaction but may carry causal semantics; the model must set causal_status accordingly.

ontology_structure.note: Ontology-structure relations, not substitutes for biological interaction.

escape.note: Escape hatch: keeps scientifically real but unclassifiable relations visible for taxonomy review; never silently dropped.

IS_A.definition: Subject is a kind of the object (taxonomic or class membership).

INSTANCE_OF.definition: Subject is an individual instance of the object class.

SAME_AS.definition: Subject and object are asserted to be the same entity.

HAS_TAXONOMIC_RANK.definition: Object states the taxonomic rank of the subject.

LOCATED_IN.definition: Subject is located in the object habitat or compartment.

FOUND_IN.definition: Subject was detected in the object site or sample.

COLONIZES.definition: Subject populations establish in/on the object host site.

HABITAT_OF.definition: Inverse of LOCATED_IN for site-to-organism phrasing.

PRESENT_IN.definition: Subject is present/detected in the object group or site (no direction of change).

INCREASED_IN.definition: Subject abundance/measure is higher in the object group; comparator must be stated.

DECREASED_IN.definition: Subject abundance/measure is lower in the object group; comparator must be stated.

MORE_ABUNDANT_THAN.definition: Direct abundance comparison between two taxa/groups.

LESS_ABUNDANT_THAN.definition: Direct abundance comparison between two taxa/groups.

ASSOCIATED_WITH_HOST.definition: Subject co-occurs with or relates to the host entity; no causal claim.

ASSOCIATED_WITH_BODY_SITE.definition: Subject relates to the object body site; no causal claim.

ASSOCIATED_WITH_DISEASE.definition: Subject relates to the object disease/condition; no causal claim.

ASSOCIATED_WITH_PHENOTYPE.definition: Subject relates to the object phenotype; no causal claim.

INTERACTS_WITH.definition: Generic ecological or molecular interaction between two microbes.

COMPETES_WITH.definition: Subject competes with object for niche/substrate.

COOPERATES_WITH.definition: Mutually beneficial interaction between two microbial entities.

CROSS_FEEDS.definition: Subject utilizes metabolites produced by the object.

CAUSES.definition: Subject is stated to cause the object outcome; requires causal wording.

CONTRIBUTES_TO.definition: Subject is one contributing factor of the object.

REGULATES.definition: Subject controls the object process (direction unspecified at predicate level).

MEDIATES.definition: Subject is the intermediate mechanism behind an outcome.

MODULATES.definition: Subject alters the object's level/activity in either direction.

BINDS_TO.definition: Molecular binding between subject and object.

UPREGULATES.definition: Subject increases expression/activity of the object.

DOWNREGULATES.definition: Subject decreases expression/activity of the object.

INDUCES_IMMUNE_RESPONSE.definition: Subject induces an immune response against/toward the object (or unspecified).

ASSOCIATED_WITH.definition: Generic association with the object disease/condition; never a causal claim.

INCREASES_RISK_OF.definition: Subject raises risk of the object outcome.

PROTECTIVE_AGAINST.definition: Evidence of a protective relationship against the object outcome, not mere co-occurrence with health.

ALLEVIATES.definition: Subject reduces severity of the object condition.

TREATS.definition: Subject intervention treats the object condition.

RESPONDS_TO.definition: Subject (microbe/community/host) changes under the object intervention.

RESISTANT_TO.definition: Subject resists the object agent (antimicrobial etc.); object must name the agent.

SENSITIVE_TO.definition: Subject is susceptible to the object agent/condition.

ALTERS_MICROBIOME.definition: Subject intervention alters the object microbial community.

TRANSMITTED_FROM.definition: Subject acquired/transmitted from the object source.

TRANSMITTED_TO.definition: Subject transmitted to the object recipient.

DERIVED_FROM.definition: Subject descends/is derived from the object source.

SHARES_SOURCE_WITH.definition: Subject and object share a transmission source.

MEASURED_BY.definition: Subject was measured/assayed by the object method (Methods relations).

DETECTED_BY.definition: Subject was detected using the object method/assay.

COMPARED_WITH.definition: Subject compared against the object group/method in the study.

VALIDATED_BY.definition: Subject finding was validated by the object method/cohort.

REPORTED_IN.definition: Subject entity/result reported in the object dataset/prior study.

HAS_RELATIVE_ABUNDANCE.definition: Object states the subject's relative abundance (verbatim value in quantitative fields).

HAS_ABSOLUTE_ABUNDANCE.definition: Object states the subject's absolute abundance.

HAS_EFFECT_SIZE.definition: Object states the effect size between subject and comparator.

HAS_P_VALUE.definition: Object states the p-value for the subject relationship.

PRECEDES.definition: Subject precedes the object in time.

FOLLOWS.definition: Subject follows the object in time.

INCREASES_OVER_TIME.definition: Subject increases along the object time course.

DECREASES_OVER_TIME.definition: Subject decreases along the object time course.

PERSISTS_DURING.definition: Subject persists during the object period/condition.

NEGATIVELY_REGULATES.definition: Down-regulatory relation (molecular level); not interchangeable with DECREASED_IN.

OTHER_RELATION.definition: Explicitly unclassified relation kept verbatim for taxonomy review.
